name: SNS — Rep Daily Log → Discord + Dashboard Refresh
description: Triggered when a rep submits daily numbers from the dashboard (/api/replog). Posts an activity summary to Discord #boiler-room, then calls back into the app to rebuild the leaderboard and master dashboard in real time.

how_to_import: 1. Go to make.com → Scenarios → Create new scenario
2. Click the 3-dot menu (top right) → Import Blueprint
4. Module 1 (Webhook): click the hook dropdown → Add → copy the generated URL
5. Module 2 (Discord): replace YOUR_DISCORD_BOILER_ROOM_WEBHOOK_URL with the real Discord webhook URL for #boiler-room
6. Module 3 (HTTP): replace YOUR_SHEETS_WEBHOOK_SECRET with the SHEETS_WEBHOOK_SECRET value from your Vercel env vars
7. Turn the scenario ON (toggle at bottom left)
8. Add the webhook URL from step 4 to Vercel: Settings → Env Vars → MAKE_REPLOG_WEBHOOK_URL

what_each_module_does.module_1: Receives POST from /api/replog. Payload: { staffName, entry: { date, callsMade, callsAnswered, demosSet, demosShowed, pitched, closed, cashCollected }, timestamp }
what_each_module_does.module_2: Posts an activity summary to Discord #boiler-room so the team sees rep activity in real time. Replace the URL with your actual Discord channel webhook URL.
what_each_module_does.module_3: Calls back into the app to trigger updatePipelineFromReplogs() which rebuilds the master dashboard and leaderboard. The x-sheets-secret header must match your SHEETS_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var exactly.

_setup_notes.note_on_google_sheets: The app already writes directly to the Setter KPI Daily Log sheet via syncReplogToSheets() — no need to add a Google Sheets step here. That would create duplicate rows.
